title: Material Blend 3-Mix Trio #04 (이레즈미+나비날개비늘+흑요암금 / 금박+보태니컬+인어비늘 / UV네온+나비날개비늘+드래곤비늘)

Pose: strong hip pop right, both hands pressing sides of hips outward simultaneously arching back to extreme — most extreme hourglass bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
